reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel, unifying mechanism—intrinsic thermal expansion mismatch generating persistent internal microstresses that couple with cold-work dislocation networks—to explain disparate observations (creep, work hardening, elastic isotropy) that are reported separately in the passages. No passage suggests thermal expansion mismatch as a governing factor, nor does any passage propose the specific intervention of modifying the alloy to reduce this mismatch as a controlled test. This integration of separate findings into a single causal framework with a new falsifiable test goes beyond the literature.
